# watchpoint_location_profile (Resource)

A location profile selecting which probe regions execute a monitor's checks.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "watchpoint_regions" "all" {}

resource "watchpoint_location_profile" "example" {
  name       = "US + EU"
  region_ids = [for r in data.watchpoint_regions.all.regions : r.id if r.is_active]
  is_default = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Human-readable profile name.

### Optional

- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the tenant's default location profile. Defaults to `false`.
- `region_ids` (Set of String) Region IDs to run checks from. Unordered; the order in configuration does not matter.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Location profile ID.
- `is_global` (Boolean) Whether this is a global, system-managed profile (read-only).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import watchpoint_location_profile.example lp_001
```
